text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while training hard for the Arima 
Kinen—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I. Ob. Ject!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: What is?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen! The Arima Kinen of all 
things! How could they possibly overlook 
this King?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Why is everyone talking about Sky-san?! 
Even though I announced I'd be running 
too!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nyahaha~. What a real pain, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, heading into this Arima Kinen, Seiun 
Sky, who captivated the crowd at the 
Kikuka Sho, was drawing the most 
attention."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"What kind of race will Seiun Sky run in 
the Arima Kinen? Expectations are soaring 
for her bag of tricks!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
In the news, on the internet—literally 
everyone is talking about you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
To think there isn't a trace of King's 
name in this... How utterly humiliating!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoa, easy there.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, their opinion flipped way too fast, 
didn't it? Takes all the fun out of 
proving them wrong, y'know~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Everyone thinks I'm "capable," so how 
should I defy those expectations...? Time 
to show off my skills♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"No, going silent all of a sudden is kinda 
creepy, you know. I was totally waiting 
for your usual comeback."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...How can you stay so completely 
composed?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
With so many expectations resting on you, 
can you really keep delivering results...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...King?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...! Please forget what just happened.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...I don't really get it, but maybe she's 
so relaxed because she's made peace with 
things.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Just write it off?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm not winning to live up to anyone's 
expectations. I win simply because I want 
to.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I was willing to do whatever it took to 
win, and people just happened to find that 
amusing.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I don't have any amazing weapons or 
anything. So I've got no choice but to 
stick to my own way~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
To put it in a cool way... Master the 
unorthodox, and it becomes the orthodox, I 
guess~

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: The royal road...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's what I'm saying. It's not 
like I can afford to relax or anything.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...I see. I understand.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*... *exhale*.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hm? King?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Sky-san!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
At the Arima Kinen, none other than King 
herself shall prevail!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to drag you down from your 
pedestal! Just you wait!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, you startled me. King, your voice 
really is so loud.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Aaah. It feels like she's brooding over 
something a bit.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Still, it'll be fine. King isn't weak, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
She'll get back on her feet on her own. 
—Somehow, I just know it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And on this day, I happened to run into 
yet another "classmate"—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, Sei-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo, Grass-chan. Heading to training 
now?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes~. It is about time I begin my final 
adjustments, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Grass Wonder glanced down at her feet. 
She had spent most of the first half of 
the Classic Year recuperating from her 
injury."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like there's no need to worry. 
So, I'll be facing Grass-chan at her 
absolute best in the Arima Kinen, huh?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, of course I'll give it my all~. And 
Sei-chan, you seem to be in fine form as 
well?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, well, you know. People just write 
whatever they want about me, desu yo?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You think so~? You don't seem to 
completely mind it, though.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"No, no! Up against Grass-chan at full 
power, I'm hopelessly outmatched! That's 
why—"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, I must do everything in my 
power to ensure there's not even a 
one-in-a-million chance of defeat~."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"—This 'Arima Kinen'... I must win it, no 
matter what."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll take my leave now~ Goodbye 
to you too, Sei-chan's Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...This might be bad.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Grass-chan. She's tuned up to way more 
than peak condition~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't look like it'll be easy to steer 
things the way everyone's hoping for, 
huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a scene that left behind an ominous 
premonition heading into the Arima 
Kinen...
